candidate.applies_to: versus_captured_output and versus_identity_replay comparisons for every layout; identity comparisons are trivially exact against themselves

identity_versus_captured.strict_equivalence_note: enforced via max_abs_error <= atol on the identity-versus-captured comparison, which at rtol=0 is exactly equivalent to zero isclose failures under the strict bound

design.cross_capture_map_reuse: two maps (identity and one perfectly balanced layout) recur across captures by construction; the measurement unit is (capture, layout), so reuse is legal and is recorded in the frozen layout index
design.deadzone_rule: a plateau is supported only where raw r strictly decreases while every adjacent-bin contrast interval lies wholly inside [-epsilon,+epsilon]; an interval crossing zero is compatible with zero and is never by itself a plateau declaration
design.equivalence_rule: only an interval wholly inside [-epsilon,+epsilon] supports practical equivalence; crossing zero alone does not
design.fresh_start_semantics: one torchrun process group per start; every start reloads all immutable artifacts and rebuilds weights before warmup
design.response_definition: start-level contrast T(a) - T(b) for two layouts of the same capture = mean of the five paired block effects; each block effect is completion_fenced_us_per_forward(a) - completion_fenced_us_per_forward(b) within the same randomized block; adjacent-bin contrasts follow r-descending layout order; identity-vs-layout contrasts measure cumulative gain

scan_study_spec.deadzone_rule: a plateau is supported only where raw r strictly decreases while every adjacent-bin contrast interval lies wholly inside [-epsilon,+epsilon]; an interval crossing zero is compatible with zero and is never by itself a plateau declaration

timing.schedule_algorithm: random.Random(seed + block).shuffle over that capture's frozen layout order (identity anchor + first-entry r-bin layouts + base anchor; every layout in the manifest is timed)
